typography.notes:
- Headings use Manrope with tight tracking (tracking-tight).
- Body uses IBM Plex Sans for excellent data readability.
- Numeric outputs in gauges use JetBrains Mono or tabular-nums to align digits.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use sharp 1px borders (border-slate-200) instead of heavy shadows. Subtle shadow-sm for interactive elements.
visual_enhancers.border_radius: Rounded-md (6px) or rounded-lg (8px) for inputs and cards. No excessive pill shapes except for small badges.
visual_enhancers.textures: Flat, clean solid backgrounds. Optical clarity.

grids.spacing: Dense but clear. p-6 for cards. gap-6 for main grid.
grids.desktop: Left column (col-span-12 lg:col-span-8) for inputs (Grid of 2 columns for form fields). Right column (col-span-12 lg:col-span-4) for sticky summary panel.
grids.mobile: Single column grid-cols-1. Summary panel should remain easily accessible.

components.inputs: Shadcn UI Input. Use a prefix icon or text for currency (e.g., '$'). Left aligned text. Apply tabular-nums.
components.labels: Small (text-sm), text-slate-600, medium weight for clarity.
components.buttons: Sharp corners or subtle rounded-md. Primary Print/Export button: bg-slate-900 text-white hover:bg-slate-800.
components.cards: Flat background (bg-white), 1px solid border (border-slate-200), shadow-sm. Used to group entry sections (Loan, Income, Housing, Debts).

motion.interactions: Hover states on all buttons and inputs. Transition colors explicitly (e.g. transition-colors duration-200). No complex page-load animations—loan officers want speed.
motion.gauges: Animate the width/fill of the DTI gauges on value change.

layout_structure.header: Clean white header with border-b, Lucide Icon (e.g., Calculator or Landmark) and Title 'LendClear DTI Calculator'. sticky top-0 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md z-50.
layout_structure.main_content: Max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8.
layout_structure.entry_section: Four main cards: 1. Loan Details (Amount, APR, Years). 2. Monthly Income (Base, Rental, Bonus, Other). 3. Housing Expenses (Tax, Insurance, HOA, Escrow). 4. Other Debts (Car, Credit Card, Other).
layout_structure.summary_section: Sticky card on right (top-24). Big 'Hero' Numbers for Front-End (Housing) and Back-End (Total) DTI. Progress bars with color coding (Safe < 28/36, Warning < 35/45, Danger > 35/45). Print/PDF Button.
layout_structure.print_styles: CSS @media print must hide Header, Print Button, and format the layout to a clean 1-column list of inputs and the final gauges.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets APCA/WCAG standards. Text over colored badges must be readable.
accessibility.forms: Use explicit labels and aria-describedby for input hints.
accessibility.data_testid: Add data-testid to ALL inputs, buttons, and result displays (e.g., data-testid='input-loan-amount', data-testid='dti-total-result').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-page React app (.js files) in the provided setup.
Use standard Shadcn components for Inputs, Labels, Cards, Progress bars, Buttons.

Implement real-time calculation logic: Monthly P&I (standard amortization formula). Front-End DTI = (P&I + Housing Expenses) / Total Income. Back-End DTI = (Front-End Expenses + Other Debts) / Total Income.
Implement print functionality using browser's window.print() and writing @media print CSS to hide UI controls and expand columns to fit a printed page.
Ensure all numbers are formatted as currency or percentages correctly.
Build visual DTI zone indicators (e.g., custom colored progress bars) indicating Safe, Warning, and High-Risk zones.
Make sure all inputs are type='number' but format them nicely if possible, or keep simple number inputs with clear labels.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
NEVER use placeholder text for logos; use Lucide icons if images are unavailable.
Ensure the tool is hyper-responsive and doesn't lose state accidentally.
Use lucide-react for all standard icons.
